key_decisions.decision: Retains the house reference and message report without moving the king to Jerusalem prematurely.
Preserves the oath and consequential replacement of Joab.
Keeps heart-turning and unity without unnecessarily naming the ambiguous immediate agent.
Reads the difficult crossing noun as a party rather than asserting a ferryboat; the crossing subject remains open.
Keeps guilt, remembrance, and heart language in Shimei’s plea.
Preserves Joseph’s house despite Shimei’s Benjaminite identity.
Keeps repeated today and renders satan as the human adversary designation in context.
Retains the unconditional wording of the spoken oath without importing later qualifications.
Keeps all three signs of neglected grooming and the full duration.
Retains pinned to Jerusalem rather than silently changing it to from Jerusalem.
Preserves first-person saddle and Mephibosheth’s own account of deception and disability.
Keeps slander allegation and deferential comparison without deciding the competing claims for the reader.
Retains the self-abasing death claim as his speech and the remembered table privilege.
Preserves the abrupt end to the hearing and divided property ruling.
Keeps the offered relinquishment and priority stated in his reply.
Keeps the full sensory questions, both genders of singers, and burden concern.
Keeps both parents and does not insert an unstated father-son relationship for Chimham.
Retains the verse’s Chimhan form and both proportions of the escort.
Keeps ten shares, the first-return claim, and the narrator’s final comparison of words.
